reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to EUR 25 million consisting of EUR 15 million committed ("Tranche 1") and EUR 10 million uncommitted financing ("Tranche 2") to provide emergency liquidity support to the City of Dnipro and key municipal utilities/operators - clients of the Bank ("Recipients") - in order to mitigate the effect of the ongoing war in Ukraine on the City's financial position. The proceeds of the Bank's investment will be used for liquidity support to the City and its key municipal companies - clients of the Bank - to compensate for temporary revenue losses and additional expenses due to the ongoing war in Ukraine. The loan will support the City's vital municipal infrastructure providers with operating (i.e., salaries, utilities, etc.) and maintenance costs, servicing the debt under existing projects with the EBRD (if required). The provisions of the EBRD Procurement Policies and Rules shall apply as appropriate. The Project is consistent with the EBRD's Resilience and Livelihoods Framework.
